get.description:
Index returns a list of inventory exports to which an org has access.
		Retrieves file list by filter params

parameters.description:
Optional filter for returning requests matching specific criteria.

The following filters are supported:
| Filter | Description | Allowed Operator | Behavior | Example |
| --- | ---| --- | --- | --- |
| id   | Filters on the export id | eq | Equal - The attribute and operator values must be identical for a match  | id eq '12345'  |
| name | Filters on the export name | co | Contains - The entire operator value must be a substring of the attribute value for a match. |  name co 'hardware' |
|      |  | eq | Equal - The attribute and operator values must be identical for a match. | name eq 'hardware_technopedia'  |
| type | Filters on the type | eq | Equal - The attribute and operator values must be identical for a match. | type eq 'Delta'  |
| createdAt | Filters on the createdAt | eq | Equal - The attribute and operator values must be identical for a match. | createdAt eq '2022-02-22'  |
| size  | Filters on the export Size | gt | Greater than - The attribute must be greater than than operator values for a match. | size gt '150'  |
|      |  | lt | Less than - The attribute must be less than than operator values for a match. | size gt '150'  |

* All operators are case-sensitive and only lowercase is allowed. 
		
		e.g: 
			valid	: eq
			invalid : EQ
* Filters can be combined using the and/or logical operator. 
		e.g: (name co 'hardware' or name eq 'software_technopedia')
	
* When used as a query string, the filter parameter value must be URL encoded.		 
	
		e.g: ?filter=(name%20co%20'hardware'%20or%20name%20eq%20'software_technopedia')
	When using cURL, the same expression can be URL encoded as follows: 
		$ curl -s {$BASE_URL}/vis/v2/orgs/{$ORG_ID}/exports \
			-H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
			-G --data-urlencode "filter=(name co 'hardware' or name eq 'software_technopedia')"
parameters.name: filter

tags.description:
**Note:** This legacy endpoint is not part of the Technology Intelligence Platform and will be retired on August 31, 2026. Please use the Query API or GraphQL API for supported access.

Export provides the ability to retrieve formatted inventory data stored in IT Visibility. Export data contains snapshot and delta information from specific points in time. These exports are automatically generated on regular intervals. All export data is retrieved in parquet format. Only inventory data associated with IT visibility and available to the organization can be retrieved.
tags.name: Export (Legacy)

tags.description:
**Note:** Effective **July 20, 2026**, all existing delta resume tokens will be invalidated. Please remove the resume token from your current request, run a new query, and use the newly generated resume token in subsequent requests to continue using delta queries.

ITV queries provide the ability to dynamically retrieve formatted, contextualized and enriched inventory data stored in IT Visibility.
tags.name: Query
